policies.first: Always choose route index 0 and affix option index 0 (T16 baseline).
policies.defensive: Prefer battle nodes over elite; prefer 坚守 (jianshou) affix, then 奇谋 (qimou), then 锋锐 (fengrui).
policies.aggressive: Prefer elite/boss nodes; prefer 锋锐 (fengrui) affix, then 奇谋 (qimou), then 坚守 (jianshou).

method.policy: Node and affix choices use only the options visible at that decision; no future route knowledge.
method.notes: 216 deterministic campaign observations across 6 lineups, 4 tiers, 3 policies and 3 seeds. Not a probability estimate. Timing includes simulation and state serialization; no front-end playback or network.

metrics.damage_to_enemies: sum of final HP damage dealt to enemies, after shields
metrics.damage_to_allies: sum of final HP damage taken by allies, after shields
metrics.effective_healing: sum of actual heal amounts applied
metrics.shield_to_allies: sum of actual shield increments applied to allies
metrics.shield_absorbed_on_allies: sum of damage absorbed by ally shields
metrics.bond_triggers: count of battle events listing each named bond
metrics.investment: actual upgrade costs plus recruit and 50% realm-up reputation costs

unavailable_metrics: heal_overflow: battle report stores effective heal only; not filled with zero
